verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
I've got a home in gloryland
That outshines the sun (x3)
Way beyond the blue

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Do Lord, O do Lord
O do remember me (x3)
Way beyond the blue

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
I took Jesus as my Saviour
You take Him too (x3)
While He's calling you

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
I will praise the name of Jesus
You praise Him too (x3)
In all things we do

verse.name: c2a
verse.lines:
This little light of mine
I'm gonna let it shine (x3)

verse.name: c2b
verse.lines:
Let it shine, let it shine
Let it shine
